node.label: Alzheimer disease 3
node.definition: Alzheimer's disease with an early onset (starts before the age of 65). It is caused by mutations in the PSEN1 gene.
synonyms: Alzheimer disease, protection against, due to APOE3-Christchurch
Alzheimer disease, type 3, with spastic paraparesis and apraxia
Alzheimer disease, type 3, with spastic paraparesis and unusual plaques

evidence.snippet: APOE is annotated as disease gene of OMIM:607822 (HPO genes_to_phenotype, OMIM-derived)
